scope: Read-only design; no source edits, tests, UI, CI, builds, installs, credentials, child agents or commits. Public official Chrome documentation read for snapshot lifetime. Only private design report written.
causal_boundary: Original frozen7f nativeB40615716489 proves test-owned Settings container/field presence survives value-only T40/T67/T37 cleanup and trips unchanged late T10 serialization comparison; not an application mode-selection bug.

Existing allowed focused suite and actual-expression/external-storage driver seams in settings-guest-scrape-controls.test.mjs/full-extension-rechecks.test.mjs/reload-boundary.test.mjs.

lifetime_decision.recommended_medium: One newly reviewed, test-owned temporary backup KEY in existing chrome.storage.local on the exclusive disposable profile. This is not a new production store/API, schema or permission. Central helper owns capture/restore/verify/dispose.
lifetime_decision.rejected: Window globals and sessionStorage disappear on panel reload. SW globals may disappear on suspension; chrome.storage.session is explicitly cleared by full extension reload. Existing full T67 absent wrapper actually spans manager reloads, so session storage is insufficient.
lifetime_decision.official_scope: Chrome documents local persistence and session storage clearing on extension disable/reload/update/browser restart. No undocumented global write-drain guarantee is inferred.
lifetime_decision.key_and_ownership: Opaque random handle and independent owner nonce minted before capture; expression contains only these opaque identifiers plus fixed Settings key. Temporary key in matrx.qa.settingsFixture.<handle> namespace; reject any existing key, never overwrite/reuse. Envelope includes schema/sourceKey/ownerNonce/sealed/present/raw inside browser. Capture succeeds only after browser readback matches the exact captured source and sealed owned backup. Node receives finite booleans/kind/phase and opaque handle only. Do not publish handle or nonce.
lifetime_decision.raw_boundary: chrome.storage.local.get/set/remove and equality evaluation run wholly inside trusted extension browser context. Raw source payload is read, copied, restored and compared inside that context; it is never returned to Node, interpolated in Runtime.evaluate/CDP strings, printed in errors/records or sent to a page/server. Use current getPanel() each phase so full reload/reacquisition does not reuse a stale target.
lifetime_decision.ownership_precondition: Only normal admitted isolated disposable acceptance profile. No whole-key restoration in Arman or shared member profile and no concurrent Settings writer/fixture owner. Refuse if ownership unavailable; no blanket key-prefix cleanup.

capture_contract: Perform existing actual Settings-open and initial UI/stored-value readiness checks first, without mutation; capture exact case-entry container immediately before first mutating control. For T37 add finite persisted scrapeDeepClean readback so initial and cleanup checks prove the actual written value, not only optimistic aria-checked.

Snapshot full fixed Settings key presence and exact raw payload; string payload comparison is byte equality including partial shape/version/unknown fields. Never parse/re-serialize the snapshot for restoration. Unknown or malformed payload is not repaired/normalized.

Absent is valid. Present current/partial string snapshots are retained verbatim. Nonstring/malformed payload retains exact original; existing UI contract may reject before mutation, or post-restoration hydration may make fixture un-restorable. Such failure is explicit, never a product pass. Do not hardcode a version or synthesize defaults.

If capture or readback fails, no case mutation/source deletion is authorized. If response/transport is uncertain, do not guess that capture did not run or delete unknown data; record capture/cleanup uncertainty and let the existing owned-profile teardown own any possible backup.
observed_cleanup_barrier_sequence: Keep every original real UI value-restoration click/select and stored-value predicate. Refactor T40/T37 inline finally through preserveFailureDuringCleanup so cleanup cannot replace original error; keep T67 existing categorized safe error/stages.

After actual persisted-value predicates, use corrected canonical reloadSettings that proves changed finite document timeOrigin plus readyState before Settings reopen. This retires old document; T40/T67 already have semantic restore reload, T37 gains equivalent stored-value + cleanup reload/reopen observation. It does not establish global pending queue drain.

In the fresh trusted context, read and validate only the owned sealed snapshot envelope, restore exactly matrx.settings.v1 (set original raw or remove only if originally absent), and await actual Chrome storage Promise completion. Leave all other application keys untouched.

Use corrected canonical document replacement/reopen again, with no subsequent setter; browser-side compare source presence/exact raw against backup plus relevant original UI baseline. Any late write/migration that changes shape fails verification and retains backup. Do not change T10 baseline/comparator, call Theme cleanup early or widen deadline.

Only after exact AFTER-reload source equality is observed, delete just the owned backup and verify its absence. Return finite restoredAfterReload/backupAbsent/phase booleans; no raw snapshot or payload fingerprint is necessary.

settlement_claim_and_limit.established: Actual case setter persisted-value readback, followed by normal old-document retirement; awaited direct restore operation; fresh-document rehydration and exact post-reload persistence equality with no further owned mutation. Exclusive fixture rules exclude intentional concurrent writers.
settlement_claim_and_limit.not_established: No test-accessible global settingsStorage.pending drain exists: save state is module-private and UI exposes only the failure alert, not saving/saved. Do not claim the full hidden queue is drained, inject production test hooks, monkeypatch Chrome storage API or add sleeps.
settlement_claim_and_limit.failure_rule: If a late app write or migration re-materializes shape, exact after-reload comparison fails and preserves backup. That is actionable fixture failure, not grounds to normalize, loop restore until green, hide a race or change comparator. A captured legacy version that migrates on reload is not silently accepted as exact-restored.
settlement_claim_and_limit.guard_requirement: A delayed write queued by the external storage driver must defeat a pre-reload-only/omitted-rehydration mutant. Native original/adjacent retest remains necessary; source guard does not prove absence of every possible later writer.

failure_disposal_contract: Successful capture establishes ownership before body. Operation and raw-restoration cleanup use preserveFailureDuringCleanup; preserve original mutable Error identity or exact primitive/frozen cause with safeCleanupFailed on cleanup failure.
Catch and project all browser errors to finite fixture phase/code; never forward Chrome error details, raw envelope/payload/keys or serialization text.
Missing/corrupt/foreign snapshot => no source overwrite/delete; explicit ownership/verification failure.

Restore, reload, readback or dispose failure => keep backup if possible, mark snapshotRetained true or unknown, never delete the only known original before verification. Existing profile teardown remains owner; remote profile deletion is unverified until actual readback, so no orphan-free claim.
Capture transport uncertainty or context loss is a failure, not retry permission. Never recover by scanning/deleting other snapshot keys or broad storage clear.

wiring_and_cycles.canonical_lifecycle: Factor/export generic exact Settings fixture lifecycle from settings-scrape-mode-baseline.mjs; reimplement its existing forced-absent wrapper by composing that lifecycle, retaining its actual absence check and full-extension execution.
wiring_and_cycles.T40_T67: Apply lifecycle inside the canonical exported actual T40/T67 runner bodies after original initial readiness and before first mutation, so warm and full T40 callers inherit it. Full T67 outer forced-absent wrapper uses the same primitive and dynamic getPanel.
wiring_and_cycles.T37: Extract actual Deep clean operation to same controls module and call from existing T37 position, preserving T28→T40→T67→snapshotPanelDocumentReload→T37 order. Add persisted-value readback and exact lifecycle; do not move it or the late T10 capture.
wiring_and_cycles.avoid_ESM_cycle: Current baseline helper imports scrapeModeMatches from controls; controls importing lifecycle would create a new cycle. Remove that helper→controls dependency by making the existing forced-absent wrapper receive the already canonical matches callback explicitly from full-extension-rechecks and its tests. Reuse the same predicate, no copy/new matcher.

mode_marker_noninterference.source_fact: guestModeShadowExpression explicitly reads only matrx.settings.v1/matrx.chat.v1/matrx.pilot-chat.v1 and fingerprints inside those values. Backup is a separate key; no comparator/filter change is needed.
mode_marker_noninterference.timing: Capture backup only after each actual sibling baseline; dispose before returning and before later immutable T10 compare. Forced-absent T67 holds backup across its own manager restarts then disposes before wrapper returns.
mode_marker_noninterference.risk: chrome.storage.onChanged has generic listeners (notably package-chat organization refresh), so do not assert marker writes are globally side-effect free. Tests must prove no mode footprint alteration from marker alone, and original native retest must remain authoritative.

actual_caller_guard_plan: Guard real T40/T67/T37 runner/caller chain using existing external UI/storage driver, evaluating actual production observation/fixture expressions and actual immutable guestModeShadowMatches. External Chrome storage and UI dependencies may be doubled; lifecycle, selectors, cleanup and comparator cannot be stubbed.

Original RED: initial Settings absent → actual sibling control call materializes full Zustand defaults → existing value-only cleanup → unchanged late T10 comparison fails same footprint serialization class, not import/timeout failure. GREEN requires exact absence after cleanup and reload.

Second/third corpus: initially present partial string with no mode/scrape fields; distinct already-present explicit full string including unknown fields/version. Both exact original bytes survive each sibling plus reload. Malformed string/nonstring/missing snapshot/collision/foreign owner/read/write/reload/delete failures stay explicit, preserve originals and never count as accepted fixture.

Primary error + successful cleanup retains exact primary; primary+cleanup error retains original/cause and safeCleanupFailed; capture failure performs no source mutation; delayed persistence/rehydration corruption must fail.

Exercise original T37 production callback through the existing executable callback seam/reload-boundary harness, not a source substring presence assertion or only an exported helper nobody calls. If that actual-caller seam cannot be driven, record/fix the missing seam before claiming guard coverage.

Use approved mutation machinery or in-memory dependency injection: omit actual lifecycle call, value-only restore, omit post-restore reload, wrong owner/key, corrupt backup, drop unknown sibling field, constant restore, leak raw result/error, omit disposal. Every named mutation must fail its own guard; do not weaken shared files by hand.

Follow source/gates/review with fresh normal hosted B original late initial comparison and complete surrounding full-extension rechecks on one frozen eligible artifact. Only actually passing scopes advance D299/D300; no Store/current-main/full-case claim from guards.

Actual extracted runCase guard: marked capture/ownership/restore/verify/dispose failures must record case_end once, retain primary identity/cause/cleanup flag and stop the next sibling mutation and late capture. Ordinary assertion and unmarked safeCleanupFailed must still record/continue; arbitrary forged marker-shaped public fields cannot trigger abort.

Execute actual exercisePanel callback and inner guestStage catch via existing source-extraction/newFunction seam from settings-reload-boundary.test.mjs. Warm marker and full dynamic-panel marker both must return to harness teardown without any later baseline/choice calls; native result remains verified and final report terminal with originating case/recheck fail. Drop-marker/rethrow-after-record/controlled-return mutants must fail independently.

Actual runFullExtensionRecheck guard must fail on swallowed marked error: finite failure criterion/result survives but same primary reaches controlled abort. Unclassified existing failure still returns its failed result and continues as before.

Final publication path must keep terminal report and source/receipt checks after controlled callback return; publication error still aborts with no fabricated terminal proof. Test current outer finally/enforcement actual source seam, not a replacement mini-runner that owns the abort logic.

admitted_checks: Normal resource helper exact currently allowlisted pnpm test:focused-acceptance, then normal admitted pnpm compile/pnpm lint; inspect policy/CLI first and honor any refusal. No local build/install/release and no arbitrary node --test path substitution.
next_action: Root scoped fresh plan re-verification of both findings, then explicit implementation authorization. No source/test/UI/CI edit performed by this design lane.

plan_findings_addressed.source_fact: Canonical local reloadSettings sends Page.reload then accepts only readyStatecomplete; old still-complete document can satisfy it. No reusable panel-document identity replacement helper was found: settings-reload-boundary probes readiness/URL/runtime, full management helper proves different target lifecycle, and Data diagnostic timeOrigin is not a replacement primitive.
plan_findings_addressed.decision: Extend the existing canonical reloadSettings body, not a private fixture-only wrapper. Read and validate finite performance.timeOrigin before Page.reload; keep existing panel_document_after_reload waitFor label/default deadline and require finite new timeOrigin != original AND readyStatecomplete before existing Settings open. Report only finite readiness/replaced flags, no raw storage. Old-ready samples remain false. Full management reload retains its existing target/worker/panel retirement helper; dynamic getPanel supplies newly reacquired panel before any later document reload.

plan_findings_addressed.source_fact: Warm runCase catches all errors, records case_end and continues. Full runFullExtensionRecheck also catches/returns; inner guestStage catch absorbs exceptions. Throwing only a safeCleanupFailed error would not stop subsequent sibling writes/baseline capture.
plan_findings_addressed.decision: Add a narrow module-owned fixture-integrity classifier/finite receipt, not a universal safeCleanupFailed failfast. It is attached only when capture/ownership/exact restore/replacement/verify/dispose is uncertain. runCase must record bounded fixture failure, preserve existing case status and publish case_end, then rethrow exact primary. Full recheck must record its fail criterion/result before rethrowing same marked error. Inner guestStage catch records bounded stage and rethrows only this marker. Whole exercisePanel body gets a selective outer catch: marker => bounded report.fixtureIntegrityFailure + controlled return, preserving harness post-exercise artifact/source verification and normal owned teardown. Unmarked errors rethrow/continue exactly as before at each original boundary. No subsequent UI mutation or baseline work occurs after controlled return.

canonical_document_reload_contract.source_files: tests/browser/settings-local-controls-acceptance.mjs reloadSettings; existing actual-helper extraction tests in settings-reload-boundary.test.mjs.
canonical_document_reload_contract.predicate: Before send: typeof origin===number && Number.isFinite(origin). After Page.reload, evaluate current origin/readiness with same waitFor; success iff current origin finite, different from captured origin, and current readyStatecomplete. Then await existing settings(panel). No Settings click on old doc.
canonical_document_reload_contract.timing: Same existing waitFor/default deadline/label; no sleep, new budget, timeout extension, retry or production test hook. Inaccessible/invalid identity or never-replaced document fails with existing reacquisition diagnostic path; never degrade to readiness-only.
canonical_document_reload_contract.scope: Canonical helper is used by body and cleanup consumers, so all document reloads gain same replacement guarantee. It proves replacement of this panel document, not global hidden Settings write queue drain, full manager reload or cross-target identity.
canonical_document_reload_contract.forcing: Run the actual extracted canonical helper with existing external CDP/DOM dependency seam. After Page.reload, feed old-origin+complete first, optionally old/loading and new/loading, then new-origin+complete. Existing Settings opening must happen only in final document; old helper fails because it clicks old complete DOM and replacement loses it. Include invalid identity/unchanged complete document failure, and omission of identity conjunction must fail. Use existing test clock/budget seam, not new production timeout.

fixture_integrity_abort_contract.authority: Closed phase enum plus WeakMap/module-owned brand in shared test-only cleanup module. Only exact-container lifecycle may register it. Do not trust arbitrary error.safeCleanupFailed or free-form caller properties. Exposed classifier returns copied finite phase/ownershipEstablished/restoredAfterReload/snapshotRetained/documentReplaced flags only; no key/handle/raw/error detail.
fixture_integrity_abort_contract.identity: Compose preserveFailureDuringCleanup as before. Lifecycle records the safe integrity phase separately; if cleanup returns a final primary Error or existing frozen/primitive-cause wrapper, register that final throwable without replacing identity/cause. Capture/owned browser failure gets fixed-message marker error with original only as private cause. Ordinary assertion with successful exact restore has no marker and keeps existing per-case continue behavior. Semantic UI cleanup failure alone is not an integrity marker if exact container is subsequently independently restored and verified; preserve its original case failure/cleanup evidence.
fixture_integrity_abort_contract.runCase: Inside its existing catch, publicationFailure retains current precedence. For classified fixture integrity, fixed c.error + finite c.fixtureIntegrityFailure and existing cleanupAlsoFailed flag, failed criterion and status; publish existing checkpoint(case_end,c.id), then throw same original. For every unclassified error the current record-and-continue behavior is unchanged. Throw after case_end, never before it.
fixture_integrity_abort_contract.full_recheck: runFullExtensionRecheck catches classified fixture failure first, sets result.statusfail/result.fixtureIntegrityFailure and records safe failed full-recheck criterion, then rethrows original instead of returning. Unclassified recheck failures keep current catch/result/continue semantics. No invented extra full-route case_end event: the existing warm case_end remains intact; full route emits its existing criterion plus outer guest stage evidence.
fixture_integrity_abort_contract.inner_guest_capture: Its existing catch records exact guestStage/guestCaptureStage and finite fixture receipt for classified error, then rethrows it to controlled exercise abort; it must not execute remaining denial/baseline/extension work. Unclassified errors retain current branch.
fixture_integrity_abort_contract.outer_controlled_abort: Wrap the existing exercisePanel body with selective catch around all its case loops and late capture/full-recheck block. Classified fixture failure => set bounded report.fixtureIntegrityFailure/report.fixtureAborted and return from callback only. This allows native harness source/receipt verification and owned browser teardown to complete and return normal result; existing outer final report publisher remains terminal. Do not route classified failure to generic setup_error if avoidable: doing so suppresses all prior verified case statuses because build.verified assignment is after exercisePanel returns.
fixture_integrity_abort_contract.verdict: The originating warm case or full-recheck result stays fail; unexecuted siblings keep unverified/missing full-recheck outcomes under existing enforcement. No success/certificate or status reset. No universal failfast for ordinary assertions, prior unrelated safeCleanupFailed errors, auth failures or publication errors.
fixture_integrity_abort_contract.top_level_fallback: If a classified error escapes due unexpected wrapping, outer catch must project fixed message/finite fixture receipt rather than String(private primary.message); preserve existing conservative setup_error/unverified path and terminal publication. This fallback is honest failure, not substitute for actual controlled-abort guard coverage.

source_unit_boundary: One coherent D300 test-harness source unit: true canonical document replacement + opaque exact-container lifecycle + all T40/T67/T37 actual callers + narrow fail-stop propagation and forcing guards. Do not declare helper-only fix complete while original callers/swallowing boundaries remain. No src/, workflow, policy, permission, auth, package, comparator or timeout change. Separate later evidence/inventory integration; native original/surrounding retest still required before closure.
